notes: Prices on the page are listed as monthly. Line 328 says annual pricing is available, but the page gives no annual prices. Done for You! is a starting price ($1,500+). Its included minutes, overage and usage terms are not published ('Inquire'). Outbound plans are based on contacts, not minutes, are separate from the inbound plans, and have no published overage. Custom outbound plans are available on request (line 279). The Business Elite plan includes initial prompt setup. Done for You! includes ongoing prompt setup and engineering. White-label and partner pricing is custom per partner and has no published price (line 303). Phone number costs are not stated on the page. The FAQ answers are collapsed. Business Lite includes blind transfer but not warm transfer. The usage estimator example (line 135) shows Business Pro at $99.00 for 150 minutes.

setup_fee.text: No setup fees. No long-term contracts. Cancel anytime.
